wa_mw_crack.notes: CATALOG DEFECT (variation start) and NAME DEFECT. Mountain Project calls it an alternate start to Robin's Ramp: a 25 ft (8 m) finger crack directly below Robin's Ramp's first bolt, about 15 ft left of that route's start, with no anchor of its own (top-roped off Robin's Ramp via a directional bolt). 'MW crack' is not a climbers' name: MP takes it from an older Index guide's label ('MW' = Mid Wall). No proper name was found. The current Index guide lists a 'Robin's Ramp 5.11 var.' (5.11a/b, 2 stars, finishes on Robin's Ramp) that is very likely this same line, but its teaser gives no start, so the match is unconfirmed. Suggest the owner rename it to something like 'Robin's Ramp 5.11 start' or fold it into Robin's Ramp. Only the access fix is proposed. MP facts for the owner: 5.11a (matches stored; agrees with the guide's 5.11a/b if they are one line), Trad/TR, 25 ft (stored 8 m matches), FA unknown (stays null), finger-size gear. theCrag answered Forbidden on its second page in the owner's Chrome (own tab, closed), so no third source.
